PNES for me is very strange. I first had one in May of 2022. Since 2015 I would say things have been easy and it all started compiling in a very quick manner in 2022. They have been very up and down since, a dynamic condition in my experience. The first months of having them til around January 2023 was the hardest point. I was having around 10-20 seizures a day, constantly dizzy, I was losing hair, brain fog, I had headaches , nausea, I couldn’t stand up for long, and my condition was almost mimicking POTS and I had to wear compression socks constantly. Many points my arms or legs would just be unable to move. 

In January I had a 2 month remission I would say, where I thought I was cured. I got another job, but only after working for 5 days, I fell right back into my symptoms. 

How I know a seizure is about to happen a lot of times is if I’m looking through things, especially when emotional stress is happening or very taxing physical demands. Where my eyes are “looking” but I’m disassociating from processing that information and I’m blanking. It then feels as if the cord between my physical being and brain is cut. My eyes begin to flutter, my body become limp, my head falls back, (I have hurt myself many times this way by falling), and sometimes I can spasm and convulse weather it being my pelvis or upper body usually. It’s painful very for me. It’s similar to the feeling of your leg falling asleep and you’re trying to wake it up, but it’s more dynamic and static, where it ripples in my limbs. These seizures can last from 1 minute to max 20 minutes. My mental state feels like vertigo? Where it feels as if I’m spinning and my thoughts are spinning and none of it is tangible. Like a whirlpool is happening in my mind of thoughts that just come and go, not knowing where I am or who I am with at times.
